# Baseline characteristics

```{r}
#| include: false
source(here::here("chapters", "_setup.R"))
n_arm <- table(clean$treatment)
```

The trial randomized `r sum(n_arm)` patients: `r n_arm[["Sugar"]]` to sugar
water and `r n_arm[["Licorice"]]` to licorice.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline characteristics by arm. Mean (SD) or n (%)."
t1 <- table_one(
  clean,
  by = "treatment",
  vars = c("age", "sex", "bmi", "asa", "mallampati", "smoking", "surgery_size")
)
knitr::kable(t1, col.names = c("Variable", "Level", "Sugar", "Licorice"))
```
